title: DEP-SEC-001A: Tier-1 dependency-security remediation (axios/postcss + Dependabot ownership)
intent: Owner-authorized Option A from PR #252 triage. Patch low-risk active client advisories within existing majors (axios 1.x → 1.19.0, postcss 8.x → 8.5.26), add .github/dependabot.yml monitoring only /packages/client (archives excluded from update intake; vite/vitest majors ignored), register MAINT-DEFER-004 ownership in SPRINTS.md, and record closeout evidence. Vite/Vitest majors, BR-021, and Python requirements-dev alert are explicitly out of scope. Archive package.json files are retained as history; their Dependabot alerts require GitHub UI dismissal (API 403 in this environment).
behavior_change: none intended - dependency patch within existing majors plus governance/config. No API, machine-control, or production Python changes. Frontend HTTP client and PostCSS toolchain versions bump only.

diff_articulation.what_changed: (1) .github/dependabot.yml created: npm ecosystem at /packages/client, weekly schedule, no auto-merge, ignore vite/vitest semver-major. (2) SPRINTS.md: MAINT-DEFER-004 / DEP-SEC-001A ownership record distinguishing Tier-1 current, Tier-2 deferred (restore = BR-021 or manual witness), ongoing Dependabot ownership. (3) packages/client: axios ^1.13.2→^1.19.0 (resolved 1.19.0), postcss ^8.5.8→^8.5.26 (resolved 8.5.26); lockfile updated via npm. Triage floors were 1.18.0/8.5.18; newer compatible releases chosen. (4) docs/ci/DEPENDABOT_TIER1_REMEDIATION_2026-08-10.md closeout with direct build witnesses and PENDING GITHUB RECALCULATION / OWNER UI WITNESS for alert dismissals.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Implements the owner-authorized Tier-1 tranche from the #252 triage. Dependency security was previously unowned; this establishes intake configuration, ownership, and the two low-risk patches without coupling to the gated Vite/Vitest major migration.
